items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: that was one of the great trombone sections, to me, that we had in Calloway's band with Keg and Tyree and myself.

ctx.x: He had a beautiful sound to me, and we had a very good section. The section blended. You know, I've never played with a bad trombone section in my whole life and that was one of the great trombone sections, to me, that we had in Calloway's band with Keg and Tyree and myself.
Well, I don't think it could be a bad trombone section if you were in there, anyway. If anybody listened to you in any kind of a way, it couldn't be bad.
